question: How do tracked ultrasound wall echoes become geometric diameter/area quantities and then an arterial pressure estimate using separate cuff and calibration inputs?

elements.role: Recorded wall echoes and peak tracking yield diameter geometry; pressure is a later model estimate.
Target d(t) and diastolic d_D define A(t), A_d and the squared diameter ratio under circular/rotational symmetry.
Brachial p_s and p_d are separately measured calibration inputs; p_d also scales the pressure estimate directly.
Systolic/diastolic area endpoints supply calibration geometry. Reused A_d notation does not assert equality with a different site's target area.
Coefficient derived from both cuff pressures and area endpoints, with subject/state and cross-site reuse assumptions.
Arterial exponential model uses the target area ratio, alpha and p_d, subject to stated vessel and calibration conditions.

relations.source: Main text/Note9.1 Eqs1–2; Note9.3 d_D definition; explicit algebraic synthesis

relations.from: target A(t)/A_d, alpha and cuff p_d

visual_design: An original staged layout separates echo tracking, target geometry, two calibration sources and estimated pressure. Two cuff routes distinguish input to alpha from direct p_d scaling. Equations preserve squared geometry and exponent grouping; notes state dimension and reuse conditions. No waveform or anatomy is reconstructed.
transferable_rules: Separate directly observed signals, derived geometry and calibrated model estimates; show external calibration measurements as their own source.
Preserve nonlinear geometry and dimensionless ratios, and distinguish calibration endpoints from target-record references even when the source reuses a symbol.
Attach conditions to their scientific role and state which quantities may transfer across state/site; conditional coefficient reuse does not establish equality of all geometry.
gaps: Rotational-symmetry note is visibly between target and calibration geometry but close to the cuff-to-alpha route; its attachment remains weak. Target/calibration A_d and s/d shorthand need the full caption; lower notes were readable at the tested preview convention but no printed-size guarantee.
Source Eqs7–8 conflict with exponential Eq1; the f extension is excluded and implementation choice remains unknown. Venous Eqs4–6 are outside the arterial explanation.
Exact cuff/geometry pairing, diastolic-reference acquisition/storage, extrema detection, invalid-domain handling and automatic recalibration are not established in the bounded read.
